stub.section: South Branch to Split Rock Falls

pointOfInterests.description: Park at the South Fork Boquet Trailhead on Highway 73 on the east side of the bridge and hike up the trail to access this run.
pointOfInterests.name: South Fork Boquet Trailhead Put In

pointOfInterests.description: You can continue on down the Boquet River.
pointOfInterests.name: Confluence with Boquet River

detail.description:
You have to earn your turns on this one, that's right hiking up with your gear.  The bottom starts off as Class 3-4 and flattens out. From here the river is pool drop. Give up and put on whenever you want, but there are big slides all the way at the top. Of course you'll have to hike to the top of those too.
